title: Stained Glasswork Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Vivid Foliage Display
description:
Bring vibrant colour and unique patterns to your garden or home!


KEY FEATURES
• Stunning deep purple foliage with bright pink patterns
• Ideal for beds, borders, patio pots, or as a houseplant
• Easy to care for and high-impact visual appeal
• Compact growth habit, perfect for smaller spaces
• Suitable for sunny and partially shaded locations


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides
Colour: Purple and pink foliage
Season: All year (indoors), Summer (outdoors)
Growth Habit: Upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Sun to Light Shade
Soil: Fertile, well-drained soil
Watering: Water freely during growing season; keep lightly moist but well-drained
Spacing: 45 cm
Height: 45 cm
Spread: 45 cm
Hardiness: H1B (UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Unpack immediately upon arrival and provide a little water if needed.
• Plant in a hole deep enough to accommodate the plug.
• Use a balanced compost, such as John Innes Compost No 2, especially when potting into containers.
• Water freely during the growing season, ensuring soil is lightly moist but not waterlogged.
• Dead-head regularly (if flowers appear) to prolong foliage display and encourage bushier growth.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
